name: pages
# Build the WebAssembly emulator and publish web/ to GitHub Pages: the emulator, the public demo
# firmware under web/wasm/fw/public, and the ESP32-S3 mask ROM ELF (Apache-2.0, espressif/esp-rom-elfs).
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Build the wasm module
        run: tools/wasm-build.sh
      - name: Fetch the ESP32-S3 and ESP32-C3 mask ROM ELFs
        run: |
          set -e
          url=$(curl -sL https://api.github.com/repos/espressif/esp-rom-elfs/releases/latest | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(next(a["browser_download_url"] for a in json.load(sys.stdin)["assets"] if a["name"].endswith(".tar.gz")))')
          curl -sL "$url" -o rom.tar.gz
          tar -xzf rom.tar.gz --wildcards '*esp32s3_rev0_rom.elf' '*esp32c3_rev3_rom.elf'
          find . -name esp32s3_rev0_rom.elf -exec cp {} web/wasm/fw/ \;
          find . -name esp32c3_rev3_rom.elf -exec cp {} web/wasm/fw/ \;
          ls -la web/wasm/fw/esp32s3_rev0_rom.elf web/wasm/fw/esp32c3_rev3_rom.elf
      - name: Version-stamp the script and module URLs (Pages caches for 10 minutes)
        run: |
          v=${GITHUB_SHA::8}
          sed -i "s|src=\"emu.js\"|src=\"emu.js?v=$v\"|" web/index.html
          sed -i "s|new Worker('wasm/worker.js')|new Worker('wasm/worker.js?v=$v')|; s|fetch('wasm/esp32sim.wasm')|fetch('wasm/esp32sim.wasm?v=$v')|" web/emu.js
          grep -c "v=$v" web/index.html web/emu.js
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: web
  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0

      - name: cache zig
        id: cache-zig
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.local/zig
          key: zig-${{ env.ZIG_VERSION }}-linux-x86_64

      - name: install zig
        if: steps.cache-zig.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: |
          curl -fsSL -o /tmp/zig.tar.xz "https://ziglang.org/download/${ZIG_VERSION}/zig-x86_64-linux-${ZIG_VERSION}.tar.xz"

          tar -xJf /tmp/zig.tar.xz -C ~/.local/zig --strip-components=1
      - run: echo "$HOME/.local/zig" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      # hand-built "\\" path) for this step to work at all: its ZIG_EXE
      # default only falls back to a Windows path when nothing overrides it
      # AND the platform looks like Windows, so plain "zig" on PATH (just
      # added above) is what actually runs here.
      - name: verify every registry.json entry
        run: bun run tools/ci-verify-registry.ts

      - name: verify ESP32-S3 pack and timing model
        run: bun run pack:esp32:gate
